Marking its 12th anniversary, the high-tech cleaning company Roborock is rolling out a series of generous discount deals from today through September 6, covering its full range of robot vacuums and other products.

The anniversary promotion spans multiple products and bundles, with discounts starting at 25% and topping out at over 50%—savings of up to US$1,600...

Saros 20

The Saros 20 (shown above) is Roborock's flagship intelligent robot cleaner, delivering unprecedented smart performance and purpose-built for larger, more complex North American homes. Key features include the StarSight Autonomous System 2.0, AdaptiLift Chassis 3.0, Carpet Intelligence System, and Smart Plan 3.0.

StarSight is the most advanced autonomous navigation system on the market, combining dual-emitter solid-state LiDAR with 3D time-of-flight technology to construct highly detailed 3D maps of the home and accurately recognize and avoid over 300 different obstacles, from stray cables to pets.

The AdaptiLift Chassis is an advanced chassis system that detects thresholds and steps, then uses motorized legs to automatically lift the Saros 20 over them—enabling uninterrupted whole-home cleaning. Likewise, the Carpet Intelligence System automatically adjusts the body height to maintain optimal suction, ensuring deep cleaning on carpets with fibers up to 3 cm long.

Smart Plan 2.0 is an AI-driven intelligent cleaning system that analyzes the unique layout of the home, flooring materials, and each occupant's behavioral patterns to automatically optimize cleaning routes.

Qrevo 2 Pro

Making its U.S. debut, the all-new Qrevo 2 Pro is the ultimate robot cleaner for pet households. Purpose-built to tackle stubborn stains and pet hair, it features the Dual Zero-Tangle System paired with 20,000 Pa suction for 100% hair removal with zero tangles. This robot cleaner easily handles pet dander and fur, cat litter, cereal crumbs, and muddy paw prints.

The trickiest scenario is dealing with both pets and long-pile carpets. The Qrevo Pro 2 comes with auto mop detachment, which leaves the mop pads on the dock to keep carpets completely dry—effortlessly solving this challenge.

F25 Steam

The F25 Steam is the ultimate cordless wet-and-dry cleaner, combining 25,000 Pa suction with 356°F VaporFlow steam cleaning.

Key features include: 80 minutes of runtime enough to clean the entire home, a 180-degree lay-flat design for reaching under furniture, blue light that reveals hidden dust, and full automatic steam self-cleaning with hot-air drying after each session.

F25 XT

If you need powerful wet-and-dry cleaning without steam, the F25 XT delivers 20,000 Pa suction and features SlideTech 2.0 wheels for a smoother, easier cleaning experience.

The F25 XT offers true edge-to-edge wet-and-dry cleaning, delivering spotless results in a single pass. The JawScrapers roller brush uses shark-tooth blade-inspired anti-tangle bristles to effectively capture hair, working with constant-pressure scraping to leave floors streak-free. It also shares the F25 Steam's 180-degree lay-flat design, while 60 minutes of runtime in Eco mode covers up to 4,400 square feet on a single charge.

More Deals

The Qrevo S Pro and two of the most popular bundles are also heavily discounted:

  • Qrevo S Pro: originally US$699.99, now US$429.99, saving US$270 (38% off)
  • Saros 20 + F25 GT bundle: originally US$1,899.99, now US$1,269.98, saving US$630 (33% off)
  • Qrevo S Pro + F25 GT bundle: originally US$999.98, now US$549.98, saving US$450 (45% off)

All promotional pricing ends September 6—shop now before it's gone.
